decisions.stepTitle: The timeline, from the transcript, the reviews and the commits (question 1)
decisions.question: What does the timeline say of the agent's side?

options.label: One line per event, from its commit message
options.why: Short; the agent's reasoning stays in the transcript.

options.label: Also quote the agent's chat replies
options.why: Much longer; the replies are long.

decisions.chosen: One line per event, from its commit message

decisions.stepTitle: A watch-only viewer for the videos (question 2)
decisions.question: How should a video play on the watch page?

options.label: A rendered video file, in the browser's own player
options.why: Plays anywhere; rendering here is slow, so one is timed first.

options.label: reelplanning's player in a watch-only mode
options.why: A change to reelplanning itself first.

options.label: The review player as it is, with better names

decisions.chosen: i guess the rendered video file is fine to start but the watch only might be useful too

decisions.stepTitle: The study page, told as a timeline (question 3)
decisions.question: How much of the timeline is open at first?

options.label: Each plan's videos and reviews open; the rest folded
options.why: About 30 of some 70 events show; one click opens a fold.

options.label: Everything open
options.why: A long page; the plans are harder to see.

options.label: Only each plan's heading
options.why: The order stays hidden until a plan is opened.

decisions.chosen: Each plan's videos and reviews open; the rest folded
decisions.why: About 30 of some 70 events show; one click opens a fold.
